scope: Selected numeric and explicitly declared boolean logic clauses, including ranges, alternatives and exceptions. Temporal, phase, method and other unstructured qualifiers remain outside scope; not complete clinical eligibility.
relation_to_v1: Author-declared expansion of the same protocols and split; exploratory reuse, not new independent clinical validation. Patient vectors are regenerated for the expanded feature set.
model: Independent empirical feature marginals with Laplace smoothing; the planner does not model value-dependent missingness, informative failures, or factual errors in verified returns.
uncertainty: Patient bootstrap conditional on these fixed protocol subsets and synthetic generators; not a CI for new protocols or clinical deployment. Exploratory multiple comparisons, no confirmatory p-value claim.
